Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields:
{"label": "PROGRAM_FAULT" | "TEST_FAULT",
 "reason_category": "WRONG_EXPECTED_VALUE" | "INVALID_SETUP_OR_API_MISUSE" | "SPEC_VIOLATED_BY_PROGRAM" | "UNEXPECTED_EXCEPTION_IN_PROGRAM" | "OTHER",
 "evidence_ids": [ids of the evidence items that support the decision, e.g. "T4", "F2", "Doc1"],
 "summary": "at most 60 words",
 "confidence": integer 0-100}
Cite evidence ids. Do not write step-by-step reasoning.
Examples of the expected form (values are illustrative only):
{"label": "PROGRAM_FAULT", "reason_category": "SPEC_VIOLATED_BY_PROGRAM", "evidence_ids": ["Doc1", "F2"], "summary": "The documented result for this input is 3 but the method returned 4.", "confidence": 70}
{"label": "TEST_FAULT", "reason_category": "WRONG_EXPECTED_VALUE", "evidence_ids": ["T3", "F2"], "summary": "The assertion expects 4 but the documented result is 3; the expectation is wrong.", "confidence": 70}
Keep the summary to one or two short sentences and end the JSON object immediately after the confidence value.
